t: Facing you is the Palace Theatre, a West End theatre with a red-brick facade that dominates the west side of Cambridge Circus. It stands behind a small plaza, near where Shaftesbury Avenue meets Charing Cross Road, and it seats 1,400. It was designed by Thomas Edward Collcutt, a Victorian architect. His other important London buildings include the Savoy Hotel and Lloyd's Register of Shipping, so this theatre sits alongside some well-known company.
